metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.4 · 1974 · The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
metas.description: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.6 · 1986 · The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
metas.description: A radio host is victimized by the cannibal family as a former Texas marshal hunts them.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.0 · 1990 · Leatherface: Texas Chainsaw Massacre III
metas.description: A California couple and a survivalist encounter Leatherface and his family.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.4 · 1994 · Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation
metas.description: A group of teenagers get into a car crash in the Texas woods on prom night, and then wander into an old farmhouse that is home to Leatherface (Robert Jacks) and his insane family of cannibalistic psychopaths.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.2 · 2003 · The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
metas.description: After picking up a traumatized young hitchhiker, five friends find themselves stalked and hunted by a deformed chainsaw-wielding loon and his family of equally psychopathic killers.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 5.8 · 2006 · The Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Beginning
metas.description: Before being sent to serve in Vietnam, two brothers and their girlfriends take one last road trip, but when they get into an accident, a terrifying experience will take them to a secluded house of horrors, with a chainsaw-wielding...

metas.name: 7 · ★ 4.8 · 2013 · Texas Chainsaw
metas.description: A young woman travels to Texas to collect an inheritance. Little does she know that an encounter with a chainsaw-wielding killer is part of the reward.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.0 · 2017 · Leatherface
metas.description: A teenage Leatherface escapes from a mental hospital with three other inmates, kidnapping a young nurse and taking her on a road trip from hell, while being pursued by a lawman out for revenge.
